title: Minimax Testing in Four-Period Fixed-Effects Logit Panels at the Rare-Event Boundary
banked_reason: Delivered tier incremental below floor field; not salvageable within scope.
gap_reasons: The contribution nevertheless applies only to a precisely balanced four-period schedule and an engineered rare-error triangular array centered at a specific intercept-slope relation.

The power collapse concerns the unusually strong requirement of level control in every realized-total fiber and therefore does not establish a general failure of conditional likelihood or ordinary conditionally valid inference.

Without extension beyond the sixteen-pattern design or evidence that the calibrated frontier governs practically relevant panels, the result remains a narrow theoretical phenomenon, which also limits its leading-journal score.
D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5.9 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved matching upper and lower bounds for the balanced T=4 rare-error experiment, including the exact microcube and N^(-1/8) heterogeneity frontiers and an intercept-uniform every-fiber calibration collapse. The mathematics and decision claims survived review, but the field-tier novelty claim collapsed because the result remains tied to an engineered sixteen-pattern design and an unusually strong calibration requirement. A credible re-raise must re-anchor to general balanced T=2m (or add comparably broad practical validation), with new pattern algebra, expansions, constants, and least-favourable mixtures.
tldr: For balanced \(T=4\) fixed-effects product-logit panels at the calibrated rare-error boundary, the paper establishes a sharp local decision phase diagram. On \(N^{-1/4}\) intercept microcubes the nuisance-minimax error is \(\Phi\{-\kappa\sqrt{a^2+(a-2M)_+^2}\}\). Any rule calibrated at level \(\eta\) in every realized-total fiber has power at most \(\eta+o(1)\), uniformly over every deterministic intercept array in \(\mathbb R^N\); by contrast, unrestricted marginal use of the random totals attains explicit power \(1-\Phi\{z_{1-\eta}-2\kappa\sqrt{a^2+(a-2M)_+^2}\}>\eta\). On enlarged cubes the exact error is \(\Phi\{-\kappa(a-\Gamma/2)_+\}\), so the advantage survives below the \(N^{-1/8}\) radius, erodes at that radius, and disappears when \(\Gamma\geq2a\).
gap: Conditional logit eliminates fixed effects and regular partial-information theory often finds small or vanishing loss, but those results do not determine exact minimax testing risk when \(T\) is fixed, probabilities drift to zero, the slope is localized at \(N^{-1/4}\), and intercept imbalance first enters through a second-order dispersion term.
fill: The project will establish matching explicit tests and least-favorable deterministic-array priors for the microcube and enlarged-cube risks, plus an every-total conditional-calibration theorem on the actual data. A corrected frontier is an acceptable resolution if the paired-pattern audit or uniform remainder changes the proposed constants.
